book.name: Aklisiyestis
book.title: Aklisiyestis Det Wed Blanga Wanbala Klebawan Titja

content: Ai nomo sabi wotfo dijan laif jidan lagijat
Wal dislot wed blanga det titja, det san blanga Deibid, hubin jidan king blanga Jerusalem.
Det titja oldei tok, “Wal ai nomo sabi wotfo ebrijing langa dijan laif jidan lagijat. Det laif im jis kipgon. Ai nomo sabi detmatj blanga dijan laif.
Wotfo yu oldei dumbat adwek blanga dijan laif? Wanim laif gibit yu? Ai nomo sabi. Im nomo album yu olagijawan.
“Wal ola pipul dai en olabat bigininimob gro en dai du, bat dijan wel im jidan seimwei.
En det san oldei gidap en godan seimwei.
En det win oldei blo langa sauth en langa nowath en im oldei go raidaran en kambek en statbek igin.
Ebri riba oldei jidan fulwan garram detmatj woda en det woda randan langa solwoda, bat det solwoda jis jidan seimwan. Det woda garra gobek igin raitbek weya imbin stat.
Wal ebrijing jis kipgon seimwei langa dijan wel. Wi gin tok, bat wi kaan tok ebrijing, en wi gin luk, bat wi kaan luk ebrijing, en wi gin irrim, bat wi kaan irrim ebrijing.
Ol dislot ting weya bin hepin bifo im garra hepin igin, en ol detlot ting deibin dum bifo dei garra dum igin. Wal nomo eni nyuwan ting jidan langa dijan wel.
Maitbi sambodi tok, ‘Yu luk! Nyuwan ting iya!’ Bat najing! Tharran bin iya longtaim bifo wibin bon.
Pipul tudei fogedabat ol detlot ting weya bin hepin bifo, en ol detlot hu garra jidan bambai, olabat garra fogedabat olabat du.”
Det titja im jinggabat blanga len ebrijing
“Wal mi na det titja hubin jidan king blanga ola Isreil pipul deya langa Jerusalem.
Aibin reken ai garra len blanga ebrijing weya pipul oldei dumbat langa dijan wel. God na bin gibit wi dijan brabli adwan wek.
“Wal aibin luk ebrijing weya pipul oldei dumbat langa dijan wel, en ai dalim yu, im brabli adwan blanga sabi. Wal im jis laik aibin trai dalimbat det win wujei blanga go.
Yu kaan streitinimap samting wen im jidan krukidwan, en yu kaan kaundim enijing wen dei nomo deya.”
Wal aibin tok miselp, “Aibin jidan brabli haibala men en brabli klebawan men langa enibodi hubin jidan king bifo mi iya langa Jerusalem en ai sabi wanim gudbala ting en klebabala ting min du.”
Aibin rili wandi len mowa ebrijing brom detlot pipul hu jidan klebabala, en blanga detlot granggibala en nogudbala pipul. Wal aibin faindat im jis laik aibin trai dalimbat det win wujei blanga go.
Wal wen yu sabi mowa yu garra abum loda wori. If yu sabi mowa yu garra jidan brabli soriwan.
